name: @gaia-react/cli
description: GAIA CLI: init/update/wiki/scaffold/setup subcommands. Maintainer source; ships to adopters as a single bundled binary at .gaia/cli/gaia. The maintainer binary at .gaia/cli/gaia-maintainer adds the release namespace and is excluded from the adopter tarball.

scripts.bundle:adopter: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --banner:js='import { createRequire as __createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=gaia.tmp && printf '#!/usr/bin/env node\n' | cat - gaia.tmp > gaia && rm gaia.tmp && chmod +x gaia
scripts.bundle:maintainer: esbuild src/index.maintainer.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --banner:js='import { createRequire as __createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=gaia-maintainer.tmp && printf '#!/usr/bin/env node\n' | cat - gaia-maintainer.tmp > gaia-maintainer && rm gaia-maintainer.tmp && chmod +x gaia-maintainer
